svg.aria-label: A three-lane timeline status board from July 25 to August 10 2026 showing what the large language model market was waiting for versus what actually happened. Lane one, the closed frontier ceiling, is a flat frozen line from Claude Opus 5's launch on July 25 through August 10 with no price cut and no model scoring above Intelligence Index 61 for sixteen days. Lane two, Alibaba's promised Qwen3.8 open weights, shows a promise made on August 4 to ship next week, a target window of the week of August 10, and an open dashed marker at August 10 meaning the weights and license have still not shipped. Lane three, governance and policy, is dormant for weeks and then lights up on August 7 with analysis that the AI Kill Switch Act exempts the evaluation environments where every triggering incident occurred. The takeaway is that both awaited model-board events failed to arrive on schedule while the one axis that moved was policy.
svg.title: The model board froze; the policy axis moved — Jul 25 to Aug 10 2026: the frontier ceiling stayed flat for 16 days and Qwen's promised open weights did not ship, while governance became the one live front (AI Kill Switch Act scrutiny, Aug 7)
svg.text: The model board froze — the one axis that moved was policy
